title: Intrinsic finite-reduction input and tensor-source comparisons
statement: Fix the finite setting P of [def-pur-conventions], 1 <= m <= P.level, and write Q for the smaller setting and red for the intrinsic derived coefficient quotient. Write E_T and E'_T for the specified intrinsic realization equivalences and S_T for fixed-scalar reduction. For any intrinsic input K on Y define the comparison S_Y(E_Y.inverse K) -> E'_Y.inverse(red_Y K) by fully faithful preimage of scalarPresentation inverse, followed by red of the E_Y counit and the inverse E'_Y counit [def-sp-finite-scalar-realization-presentations]. For f:X -> Y, X over the base, and d a natural number, define red_X(E_X(P.smoothPurityTensorSource f d K)) -> E'_X(Q.smoothPurityTensorSource f d (red_Y K)) by scalarPresentation, the realized finiteTensorPurityTargetComparison at E_Y.inverse K [def-pur-finite-tensor-fixed-comparisons], and tensoring the pullback of the input comparison with the identity on Q.diagonalTwist X d. These are the specified composites, independent of any purity morphism or diagonal orientation [def-pur-smooth-purity-map].
